name: com.ld.sdk.account.ui.floatview.FlyingBallService
description: The Eyuan (YYXXGame) Leidian account SDK binds this Service to show or hide its floating ball during gameplay; the ball can display account notices and coupon tips.
disableEffect: The floating account shortcut and its notice or coupon tips disappear; the separate Leidian sign-in screen remains available.
